key: EVE: Give me a little time.
en: EVE: Give me a little time.
ja: イヴ: ちょっと時間をちょうだい。

key: I used this old tablet to measure environmental factors when I was looking for Shaymin.
en: I used this old tablet to measure environmental factors when I was looking for Shaymin.
ja: シェイミを探してたとき、この古いタブレットで環境要因を測定してたの。

key: Given a few tweaks, I should be able to use it to tell us a bit about what's going on here...
en: Given a few tweaks, I should be able to use it to tell us a bit about what's going on here...
ja: 少し調整すれば、これでここで何が起きてるのか、ある程度わかるはずよ……

key: EVE: I think specifically you'll need to balance the power of both sides...
en: EVE: I think specifically you'll need to balance the power of both sides...
ja: イヴ: 具体的には、両サイドの力を釣り合わせる必要があると思うわ……

key: I'm working on a way to measure this numerically; just hold on.
en: I'm working on a way to measure this numerically; just hold on.
ja: これを数値化する方法を考えてるところだから、ちょっと待ってて。

key: EVE: Oh, for the--
en: EVE: Oh, for the--
ja: イヴ: もう、なんなの――

key: There is literally no reason you should be crashing on that of all things!
en: There is literally no reason you should be crashing on that of all things!
ja: よりによってそれでクラッシュする理由なんて、文字通りひとつもないでしょ!

key: Didn't I just fix--
en: Didn't I just fix--
ja: さっき直したばっかりじゃ――

key: ...Tch.
en: ...Tch.
ja: ……チッ

key: EVE: Ah, you're back already.
en: EVE: Ah, you're back already.
ja: イヴ: あら、もう戻ってきたのね。

key: That'll be the first of hopefully several reliefs.
en: That'll be the first of hopefully several reliefs.
ja: 願わくは、これが最初のひと安心になるといいけど。

key: We've no idea what sort of phenomenon this is...
en: We've no idea what sort of phenomenon this is...
ja: これがどんな現象なのか、まだ全然わかってないの……

key: On top of the loss of color and the sudden door, now we've got all these Pokémon which don't seem to be entirely real.
en: On top of the loss of color and the sudden door, now we've got all these Pokémon which don't seem to be entirely real.
ja: 色が失われたことと、突然現れた扉に加えて、今度は完全に実在するとは思えないポケモンまで出てきたし。

key: Heather also said she saw some kind of barrier around the top of the three, and went to try and break through.
en: Heather also said she saw some kind of barrier around the top of the three, and went to try and break through.
ja: ヘザーも、頂上の周りに何かバリアのようなものが見えるって言って、突破しに行ったわ。

key: NOEL: These Pokémon are fighting.
en: NOEL: These Pokémon are fighting.
ja: ノエル: これらのポケモンは戦っています。

key: NOEL: They're fighting.
en: NOEL: They're fighting.
ja: ノエル: 戦っています。

key: There's two clear sides, but no way forward.
en: There's two clear sides, but no way forward.
ja: はっきりと二つの側に分かれていますが、先へ進む道はありません。

key: Do we do something?
en: Do we do something?
ja: 何かする必要がありますか?

key: NOEL: Maybe we need to match them up?
en: NOEL: Maybe we need to match them up?
ja: ノエル: 組み合わせを合わせる必要があるのかもしれません。

key: There's an obvious odd one out.
en: There's an obvious odd one out.
ja: 明らかに一つだけ浮いているものがあります。

key: I would know.
en: I would know.
ja: 私にはわかります。

key: NOEL: Oh.
en: NOEL: Oh.
ja: ノエル: あ。

key: Maybe we can't eliminate all of one side.
en: Maybe we can't eliminate all of one side.
ja: 片方の側を全部倒すことはできないのかもしれません。

key: NOEL: That ladder appeared.
en: NOEL: That ladder appeared.
ja: ノエル: あのはしごが現れました。

key: You can go ahead.
en: You can go ahead.
ja: 先に進んでいただけます。

key: EVE: Got it!
en: EVE: Got it!
ja: イヴ: わかった!

key: EVE: These apparitions aren't real Pokémon, but manifestations of unstable energy in the area.
en: EVE: These apparitions aren't real Pokémon, but manifestations of unstable energy in the area.
ja: イヴ: これらの幻影は本物のポケモンじゃなくて、このエリアの不安定なエネルギーが具現化したものよ。

key: I believe it's similar to the Anomalous and Umbral energies we've already observed numerous times.
en: I believe it's similar to the Anomalous and Umbral energies we've already observed numerous times.
ja: これまで何度も観測してきた、アノマリーとアンブラルのエネルギーに似たものだと思うわ。

key: In order to open a way forward, the two opposing energies will need to be stabilized.
en: In order to open a way forward, the two opposing energies will need to be stabilized.
ja: 先へ進む道を開くには、対立する二つのエネルギーを安定させる必要があるの。

key: In other words, we need to balance the two sides against each other.
en: In other words, we need to balance the two sides against each other.
ja: つまり、両サイドを互いに釣り合わせないといけないってこと。

key: ...Perhaps you've already figured that much out, given that you got up here,
en: ...Perhaps you've already figured that much out, given that you got up here,
ja: ……ここまでたどり着いたってことは、もうそのくらいは分かってるのかもしれないけど、

key: But keep listening, okay?
en: But keep listening, okay?
ja: でも、そのまま聞いてて、いい?

key: I've pulled some data, and I should be able to tell you exactly which Pokémon to fight in order to balance the two sides.
en: I've pulled some data, and I should be able to tell you exactly which Pokémon to fight in order to balance the two sides.
ja: データを引っ張ってきたから、両サイドを釣り合わせるためにどのポケモンと戦えばいいか、正確に教えられるはずよ。

key: For instance, here, we've got Chingling, Espeon, and Mightyena.
en: For instance, here, we've got Chingling, Espeon, and Mightyena.
ja: 例えば、ここにはリーシャンとエーフィとグラエナがいるわね。

key: I can detect that the power of the Anomalous side is 7, and the power of the Umbral side is 5.
en: I can detect that the power of the Anomalous side is 7, and the power of the Umbral side is 5.
ja: アノマリー側の力は7、アンブラル側の力は5だって検出できる。

key: Furthermore, we can detect and express each individual Pokémon's power level as a prime value between 1 and 20.
en: Furthermore, we can detect and express each individual Pokémon's power level as a prime value between 1 and 20.
ja: さらに、それぞれのポケモンの力の値を、1から20までの素数として検出・表現できるの。

key: Here, Espeon has a power level of 3, each Chingling has a power level of 2, and Mightyena has a power level of 5.
en: Here, Espeon has a power level of 3, each Chingling has a power level of 2, and Mightyena has a power level of 5.
ja: ここでは、エーフィの力の値は3、リーシャンはそれぞれ2、グラエナは5ね。

key: Using this information, you can easily conclude which Pokémon needs to be fought in order to balance the energy.
en: Using this information, you can easily conclude which Pokémon needs to be fought in order to balance the energy.
ja: この情報を使えば、エネルギーを釣り合わせるためにどのポケモンと戦えばいいか、簡単に判断できるはずよ。

key: EVE: The power of the Anomalous side is 7, and the power of the Umbral side is 5.
en: EVE: The power of the Anomalous side is 7, and the power of the Umbral side is 5.
ja: イヴ: アノマリー側の力は7、アンブラル側の力は5。

key: Each individual Pokémon's power level is expressed as a prime value between 1 and 20.
en: Each individual Pokémon's power level is expressed as a prime value between 1 and 20.
ja: 各ポケモンの力の値は、1から20までの素数として表現される。

key: Here, Espeon has a power level of 3, each Chingling has a power level of 2, and Mightyena has a power level 5.
en: Here, Espeon has a power level of 3, each Chingling has a power level of 2, and Mightyena has a power level 5.
ja: ここでは、エーフィの力の値は3、リーシャンはそれぞれ2、グラエナは5。

key: EVE: Right, one more thing to mention then.
en: EVE: Right, one more thing to mention then.
ja: イヴ: それじゃ、もう一つだけ言っておくわね。

key: Because we need to balance the energies to open the way forward, eliminating one side or the other won't do.
en: Because we need to balance the energies to open the way forward, eliminating one side or the other won't do.
ja: 先へ進む道を開くにはエネルギーを釣り合わせる必要があるから、どちらか一方を全滅させるだけじゃダメなの。

key: The actual power levels on each side must be equal to each other and greater than zero.
en: The actual power levels on each side must be equal to each other and greater than zero.
ja: 両サイドの実際の力の値は、互いに等しく、かつゼロより大きくないといけないわ。

key: EVE: Flawless!
en: EVE: Flawless!
ja: イヴ: 完璧!

key: What's next?
en: What's next?
ja: 次はどうする?

key: NOEL: All Pokémon battles are is just a calculation of strength and numbers anyway.
en: NOEL: All Pokémon battles are is just a calculation of strength and numbers anyway.
ja: ノエル: ポケモンバトルなんて、所詮は力と数字の計算にすぎません。

key: NOEL: Just take out one Chingling.
en: NOEL: Just take out one Chingling.
ja: ノエル: リーシャンを一体倒すだけです。

key: NOEL: This is simple.
en: NOEL: This is simple.
ja: ノエル: これは簡単です。

key: NOEL: Do you want to reset this floor?
en: NOEL: Do you want to reset this floor?
ja: ノエル: この階をリセットしますか?

key: NOEL: She's coming.
en: NOEL: She's coming.
ja: ノエル: 彼女が来ます。

key: EVE: More?
en: EVE: More?
ja: イヴ: まだあるの?

key: Give me one second, and I'll get the numbers...
en: Give me one second, and I'll get the numbers...
ja: ちょっと待って、数字を出すから……

key: EVE: Got it.
en: EVE: Got it.
ja: イヴ: わかった。

key: The Anomalous side once again has a power of 7. The Umbral side has a power of 10.
en: The Anomalous side once again has a power of 7.  The Umbral side has a power of 10.
ja: アノマリー側の力は再び7。アンブラル側の力は10よ。

key: Togetic has a power level of 7, while--
en: Togetic has a power level of 7, while--
ja: トゲチックの力の値は7で――

key: EVE: Um?
en: EVE: Um?
ja: イヴ: え?

key: EVE: That was close!
en: EVE: That was close!
ja: イヴ: 危なかった!

key: Why is this happening now?
en: Why is this happening now?
ja: なんで今になってこんなことが……?

key: EVE: ...It's not safe for me to stay here.
en: EVE: ...It's not safe for me to stay here.
ja: イヴ: ……ここにいるのは危険ね。

key: Noel, take this.
en: Noel, take this.
ja: ノエル、これを持って。

key: Noel caught the tablet!
en: Noel caught the tablet!
ja: ノエルはタブレットを受け取った!

key: EVE: Use that to proceed.
en: EVE: Use that to proceed.
ja: イヴ: それを使って先に進んで。

key: I'll do what I can from the outside.
en: I'll do what I can from the outside.
ja: 外からできることをやるわ。

key: NOEL: ...
en: NOEL: ...
ja: ノエル: ……

key: Just us.
en: Just us.
ja: 私たちだけですね。

key: NOEL: ...I don't know how to use this.
en: NOEL: ...I don't know how to use this.
ja: ノエル: ……これの使い方が分かりません。

key: I see the totals, but not which numbers match up to which species.
en: I see the totals, but not which numbers match up to which species.
ja: 合計は見えますが、どの数字がどの種族に対応するかは分かりません。

key: Still, there's only a finite number of possibilities for any given set up.
en: Still, there's only a finite number of possibilities for any given set up.
ja: それでも、どんな組み合わせでも、可能性の数には限りがあります。

key: We can brute force it if we have to, but given that each power value is prime, it should be easy to deduce from the given information.
en: We can brute force it if we have to, but given that each power value is prime, it should be easy to deduce from the given information.
ja: 必要なら力ずくでもできますが、それぞれの力の値が素数である以上、与えられた情報から導くのは簡単なはずです。

key: 7 on the light side. 10 on the dark.
en: 7 on the light side. 10 on the dark.
ja: 光側は7。闇側は10。

key: This is simple.
en: This is simple.
ja: これは簡単です。

key: I'll follow your lead.
en: I'll follow your lead.
ja: あなたに従います。

key: Ask me if you want to check the room's totals, go over past data, or heal your Pokémon.
en: Ask me if you want to check the room's totals, go over past data, or heal your Pokémon.
ja: この部屋の合計を確認したいときや、過去のデータを見返したいとき、ポケモンを回復させたいときは、話しかけてください。

key: Skip Rhodochrine Tree Puzzle on this file?
en: Skip Rhodochrine Tree Puzzle on this file?
ja: このファイルでは、ロドクラインツリーのパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Rhodochrine Tree Puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Rhodochrine Tree Puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブデータで、ロドクラインツリーのパズルクリアが検出されました。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
